notes: Corpus is gitignored (data/legalbenchrag/) and not redistributed; corpus_sha256 pins the exact file used. Wall time is machine-dependent (171.19 s on the machine that wrote this receipt, against 349.94 s and 160.55 s in the two superseded receipts; wall clock moves with the environment, not the code). This measures clause segmentation (span containment and enclosure tightness), NOT query-answering accuracy, and NOT deal-point accuracy: there is no M&A playbook among the 23 named modes, so no per-category or recall number comparable to the product-mode table can be produced without authoring one. These numbers were produced from the branch's WORKING-TREE code, which carries the dotted-clause-number fix to detect_clause_starts; that fix is not yet contained in the commit git_commit names (74ce840), so the stamp is the branch point, not the exact tree that ran. The same-environment baseline was measured here by re-running the PRE-fix code on this machine: containment 0.803804, token-F1 0.182747, query coverage 0.856205 -- these reproduce the superseded 2026-09-22 receipt exactly, so this corpus's before/after is a genuine same-environment comparison. Against that baseline the fix is a mixed result and it is reported as such: containment FELL 0.803804 -> 0.798168 and query coverage 0.856205 -> 0.850239, while enclosure tightness improved, token-F1 0.182747 -> 0.190353. The later change sharing one trailer between the start rule and the level rule (any non-word separator, `:`, `)`, `-`, `/`, `,` ...) was re-run the same day and moved only the enclosure number: containment and coverage are unchanged at 0.798168 / 0.850239, while token-F1 ticks 0.190268 -> 0.190353 (10 extra clause starts across 9 documents). The mechanism is finer segmentation: splitting more precisely tightens enclosures (which lifts token-F1) but a new boundary can land inside a single large gold span, so that span is no longer contained and the containment/coverage rates dip. MAUD is therefore the counter-example to CUAD (whose containment ROSE 0.907796 -> 0.933728, +2.59 pp on the same-environment baseline) and is not omitted. Mean token-F1 is taken over every evaluated span with a non-contained span counted as 0. git_commit is informational; the top-level provenance pin is the authoritative content pin.
